summary: In tile-3-0, roi_caption renders as nearly illegible tiny text. Recognition and representation preserve its three lines, 223×64 bounds, and 18-unit font; layout retains those bounds with font_scale=1. The collapse appears during export/rendering and also affects other multiline text. Inspect multiline spacing conversion and autofit rather than enlarging upstream text.
strategy: Validate exported multiline font sizes and line-spacing units against scene styles; ensure autofit does not shrink correctly sized text boxes during export.
